g.text: VOLLEY-G5-ACR1
Mass properties, material classes and fabrication boundary
OUTLINE / PRELIMINARY ENGINEERING — dimensions in mm; no general manufacturing tolerance assigned
D06 | Revision A | 25 October 2026 | A3 landscape
Source: frozen ACR1 native geometry and paired BOM/verification. Do not scale; stated dimensions govern.
Academic engineering outline
NOT A MANUFACTURING RELEASE
HOME native assembly: 387 parts; loaded 197.556720 kg = dry 149.556720 + payload 48.000000.
Retained sled with pallet: 13.127806 kg. Mission device: 156.556720 kg; loaded device: 204.556720 kg.
Extra 7.000 kg power/control allowance has NO assigned position and is excluded from CAD CG/inertia.
Represented dry inertia about its own CG [kg·m²], full tensor, source sign convention:
Materials are assigned density classes; no alloy temper, coating, bond specification or supplier certification is assigned.
Aluminium 2700; steel 7850; copper 8960; NdFeB 7500; polymer 1410; insulator 1800 kg/m³.
Catalog/payload envelope mass distributions remain approximate; see exact per-group source boundaries.
BOM_HOME.csv contains all native part labels, assigned masses, CG coordinates, volumes and source notes.
MASS_PROPERTIES.json retains all eight native-state accepted group CG/inertia records.
PRELIMINARY FABRICATION ROUTE
Frame/pallet: stock machining and joint/inspection planning remain to be detailed from the owned solid model.
Copper phases: preserve connected topology, minimum return section and insulation gaps; joining/insulation process unselected.
Guides, screws, bearings, brakes and actuators: source envelope/reference only where catalog interfaces are unselected.
No fastener torque, interference fit, vacuum material compatibility or supplier acceptance is invented by these sheets.
